name: Martim S. Gaspar
bio: I am a PhD student at UNC-Chapel Hill focused on brain-computer interface hardware. I am interested in custom ASIC design for neural recording systems, particularly in building near-probe signal processing architectures that interface directly with high-density electrode arrays.

name: Eric Wu
bio: I am a second-year PhD student in Computer Science. My research focuses on hardware design for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), with an emphasis on custom chip architectures. My broader interests include embedded systems, real-time systems, and signal processing.

name: Erik Jessen
bio: I am a PhD student at UNC-Chapel Hill. I'm interested in creating an open-source CI/CD flow for multi-processor, low power designs that complies with FDA Class-3 and cybersecurity requirements.

name: Anudeep Deekonda
bio: An Electrical Engineering graduate from USC specializing in ASIC/Digital Design and Low-Power Computer Architecture. Currently serving as a BCI Processor Design Intern under Prof. Raghav's research group, where I manage the RTL to GDSII Physical Design flow and optimize neural decoding algorithms for hardware integration.

name: Saidatha Kasani
bio: Hey, my name is Sai! I'm a double major in Computer Science and Business with a minor in math. Some cool things about me are that I'm a powerlifting world champion, I'm training to be a Red Bull stuntman, and I play the guitar!

name: Rathishsai Surineni
bio: I am a Neuroscience Major and a sophomore/second year. Broadly, I am interested in computer-based applications of neuroscience, but specifically, I am interested in the role of the vagus nerve in epilepsy.

name: Anish Sharma
bio: Computer Science and Mathematics sophomore, interested in all applications of technology. Loves to play basketball and go to the gym.

name: Jason Li
bio: I am a second year computer science major. I want to gain experience in a team environment and with verification systems.

name: Jingyi Fan
bio: I am a freshman double majoring in Computer Science and Mathematics. I am interested in embedded systems and brain–computer interfaces, particularly in how computing systems can interact with neural signals and real-world devices.

name: Brenton Lian
bio: Computer Science and Data Science double major, history minor. Primary research is in cybersecurity but previous experience and interest in human computer interaction work and health related applications of computer science.

name: Ye Mon Thant
bio: I'm Ye Mon, a senior studying Computer Science at UNC. I'm passionate about efficiency and will be volunteering on the systems engineering side of this BCI project.

name: David Li
bio: Hi! I'm David, a sophomore at UNC studying computer science and mathematics. I'm interested in low level development and infrastructure. In my free time, I like to play tennis and ping pong.

name: Ethan Bonsall
bio: Junior studying Computer Science and Data Science, with an interest in research that has a direct path to helping people and creating practical real-world impact.

name: Douglas Parker
bio: I am a second year student studying Computer Science and Data Science. My research interests lie in open source hardware design, machine learning, and local compute.

name: Xiao Tan
bio: Junior at UNC Chapel Hill interested in hardware security, computer architecture, low-level systems, and logic/verification.

name: Vihan Patil
bio: Hi! I am a student at UNC studying CS and Math interested in the intersection of low-level embedded systems programming and machine learning.

name: Noah Stiggins
bio: Hello! I am a freshman pursuing a double major in Computer Science B.S. and Business Administration B.S.B.A. My primary interest is in Cybersecurity and the way that we interact with the internet in our daily lives.

name: Xinyue Yang
bio: Xinyue is a sophomore at UNC–Chapel Hill majoring in Computer Science and Statistics. She is a member of the Embedded Team, with research interests in embedded systems and full-stack development.

name: Sanya Saqib
bio: I am a freshman majoring in Computer Science with minors in Business Administration and Arabic, working on the Software Engineering team for the project. I'm interested in building impactful, human-centered technologies, and outside of academics, I enjoy photography and watching Formula 1!
